# Frontend contract inventory

This document also owns the P0 frontend migration acceptance ledger below. Public Seam exports and consumer targets remain canonical in `docs/frontend-seam-inventory.md`; do not maintain a second export inventory here.

This inventory defines protected frontend contracts and their current sources of truth. The completed DDD reorganization is recorded in #690 and its child issues; its migration manifest was retired in commit `7e9a3dc5` and remains available in Git history. Subsequent contract changes must be explicit and verified against the current API and owning context.

## Non-contract internals that may be renamed

TypeScript filenames, Vue component names, feature-local DTOs, adapters, composables, and internal query-key helper filenames may be renamed when all consumers are updated and the relevant tests pass. Generated API wrappers remain generated and must not be hand-edited.

## Change gate

If a change touches a protected contract, stop the directory migration and create a separate migration specification plus ADR. Do not hide semantic changes inside a move or rename.

## P0 migration acceptance freeze

Historical P0 snapshot: 2026-10-10; integrator: `/root`; current checkpoint: `70e5758eddad32b588eaf641d1a470848283b0d4`. This checkpoint has no attached green CI evidence and is not an immutable migration rollback SHA. This frozen snapshot did not itself authorize P1 execution; the current P1 result is recorded below.

One frozen ID identifies each TypeScript AST matcher call site in specs containing a direct `readFileSync`, `readFile(`, or `?raw` source marker. Loops/table cases are not expanded. Test titles include `it.each` and templates; repeated assertions get occurrence IDs. This scope is a syntactic candidate scan, not helper-derived dataflow analysis. Implementation layout/style constraints retire only after effective replacements. Numerical luminance/contrast and rendered behavior remain protected; tool-policy fixtures remain fixtures. All 18 undecided i18n candidates stay frozen with proposed phase and owner until tool selection, before P7. No assertion is deleted in P0.

Reproduce from `apps/web`: `npx tsx scripts/checkFrontendMigrationLedger.ts`; append `--self-test` for schema/AST/phase-gate fixtures, `--strict` for consistency, or `--phase=P1` / `--phase=P2` for cumulative phase acceptance through P1 / P2. Future phase obligations remain pending without blocking earlier phase acceptance. New source-read files, changed/missing matchers, changed behavior evidence and path drift produce P0 review warnings. `--strict` rejects drift for migration review; passing proves inventory consistency, not completion of pending replacements or scenarios. Each retirement needs an effective positive/negative lint fixture or observable behavior replacement before its original assertion is deleted.

Measured `R=403`, plus 18 frozen i18n candidates awaiting assignment; mandatory `B=57` distinct scenarios. At the P0 freeze, twenty-five existing observable scenarios have exact mappings and local verification evidence from the full non-browser test run; 32 scenarios were pending. Missing scenarios retain concrete expected assertions. The P3 Query trio awaits accepted P2.5 design. P7 cannot pass with pending requirements or unassigned i18n candidates.

P1b has eight planned packages totaling 56 net working hours. The working-day baseline is 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-21; these are estimates, not actual hours or completed dates. This is the frozen estimate; current execution evidence is recorded in the ledger below. Calendar dates do not start a lane. Actual hours, completion dates, rolling HEAD, immutable green rollback SHA and CI evidence remain distinct. Fix-forward is limited to 8 net working hours or one working day, whichever comes first; the integrator then stops assigning packages until the plan owner chooses revert or replanning.

All 680 measured `src/shared` files have destinations: 263 ordinary files are listed individually, and 417 generated files use a directory pattern, count and sorted source-path SHA-256. Generated drift verifies contents. Consumers refer to canonical Seam records when available; other files carry direct runtime/type cruiser evidence. Exact file overrides precede horizontal directory rules. Generic UI/browser/auth capabilities remain horizontal with documented reasons even when current consumers belong to one feature. All canonical CONTEXT paths are mapped; they remain English. Public export/surface/shim/fan targets belong only to `docs/frontend-seam-inventory.md`.

Historical P1 audit correction, 2026-10-10: relocation preserves the original 494 frozen matcher IDs and `R=403`; the 90 relocated P1b source constraints remain retirement obligations within the original `R_p=149`. Three ownership-path-only assertion updates have separate reviewed mappings. Current destinations are checked individually; generated targets project back to the original 417 source paths and SHA-256. The new theme keyboard spec is inventoried separately (28 behavior matchers and five source-text constraints pending at that audit; their completed retirement is recorded below) without changing frozen IDs or quotas.

P1 is **COMPLETE locally**: full normal/production strict Knip, strict P1 gates, relevant verification and independent review passed. CI and committed checkpoint evidence remain unset until actually available. All 149 frozen P1b matchers and five supplemental source checks have now been retired after effective semantic lint or observable browser replacements. The four previously pending mandatory scenarios have verified evidence: 417 byte-identical generated files plus actual Orval drift, concurrent/repeated 401 redirect-once, all eight service labels in four locales, and real user/Admin controls and dialogs in light/dark and normal/reduced motion. Frozen IDs and quota denominators remain unchanged. `--strict` checks consistency; `--phase=P1` also requires completed retirement and effective replacement/behavior evidence.
